name: MRR overview
prompt: MRR overview: new MRR added by month, headline MRR and account KPIs, and the split by plan and industry.

binding.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', started_at) AS month, ROUND(SUM(mrr),0) AS mrr FROM subscriptions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

copy.title: New MRR added by month
copy.caption: New monthly recurring revenue has grown steadily from about $33K a month in early 2024.

binding.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(mrr),0) AS mrr FROM churn_risk

copy.title: Total MRR
copy.caption: $735K in monthly recurring revenue across 600 accounts.

binding.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM churn_risk
SELECT ROUND(SUM(mrr)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),0) AS avg_mrr FROM churn_risk
SELECT SUM(seats) AS seats FROM churn_risk
SELECT plan AS plan, ROUND(mrr,0) AS mrr FROM mrr_by_plan ORDER BY mrr DESC

copy.title: MRR by plan
copy.caption: Revenue is split almost evenly across the four plans — none clears $160K.

binding.sql: SELECT industry AS industry, COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM churn_risk GROUP BY industry ORDER BY accounts DESC

copy.title: Accounts by industry
copy.caption: Accounts are spread evenly across five industries.
